subject: Goron Cell Switch
text: Stepping on the switch in the hall opens the Goron's double-sided cell doors.

evidence.quote: Step on it, and the Goron's double-sided cell doors will open.

subject: Goron Cell Chest
text: Opening the chest inside the Goron's cell yields a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Speak with the Goron and open his chest to get another Small Key.

subject: Three-Tiered Room Wire Wall
text: Climbing the wire wall leads back up to the Boulder Maze.

evidence.quote: Turn around and go back down the hall, and use the wire wall to climb back up to the Boulder Maze.

subject: Pierre the Scarecrow
text: Playing the Scarecrow's Song summons Pierre the Scarecrow onto the wall platform in the Boulder Maze.

evidence.quote: Play the Scarecrow's Song, and Pierre the Scarecrow will appear up on the platform.

subject: Pierre's Platform
text: Using the Hookshot on the circular target allows Link to pull himself to a rising elevator platform.

evidence.quote: Pull yourself over to this platform, and the platform will begin to rise. Ride the elevator to the top of the shaft, and go through the door adjacent to the elevator.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula token is obtained by killing the skulltula on the corner wire mesh in the Two-Tiered Room.

evidence.quote: Climb the wire mesh to the next level, and look to the wire mesh in the corner to spy a Gold Skulltula.  Kill it and take it's token

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula hangs on the cliff wall above the pit in the Time Trial Room.

evidence.quote: As soon as you enter the room, walk forward to the edge of the cliff and look to the left to spy another Gold Skulltula hanging on the cliff wall above the pit.  Kill it and take it's token with the Hookshot.

subject: Time Trial Chest
text: Stepping on the switch temporarily removes the flames around the chest containing 200 rupees.

evidence.quote: The pillar of flames surrounding the chest at the top of the room will now disappear, and you have a limited to time to open the chest before the flames return...Once you have the 200 rupees, then drop down to the Narrow Span room through the pit in the center of the room.

subject: Narrow Span Room South Door
text: Heading through the south door leads back to the Lava Curtain Room.

evidence.quote: Head through the south door (to the right of the sealed door, closest to the silver eye target) to return to the Lava Curtain Room.

subject: Lava Curtain Room Sandstone Ledge
text: Jumping from the jutting platform to the west-center sandstone ledge leads to a locked door.

evidence.quote: Jump from this piece of the platform up to the sandstone ledge (it looks like a jump you can't make, but you can).  Go through the locked door.

subject: Fire Trap Room Maze
text: Navigating the maze requires keeping the wall on the right, turning left at flame walls, and turning right after posts.

evidence.quote: Keeping the wall on your right side, move slowly forward until a wall of flames appears in your path.  Go to the left (watch out for a roving boulder), and take a right immediately after passing the first post on your right.  Go right again and head back towards the wall to find a door.

subject: Compass Corridor Chest
text: Opening the chest at the end of the hall reveals the Compass.

evidence.quote: Run to the end of the hall and open the chest to find the Compass.

subject: Fire Trap Room Totem Path
text: The path past the fire-spitting totem pole requires hugging the left wall and passing between two poles to reach the exit door.

evidence.quote: Watch out for the giant totem pole here; the faces spit fire.  Hug the wall and go around, keeping your left side facing the wall...When another wall of flames appears in your path, go right and pass between the pair of poles directly in front of you.  Take a left immediately on the other side, and you'll reach the door.

subject: Fire Curtain Switch
text: Pressing the switch behind the fire wall temporarily drops the giant curtain of flames on the north side of the room.

evidence.quote: Go to the left and pass between the pair of posts just to the left of the fire wall, and you can reach the switch.  The giant curtain of flames on the north side of the room will now disappear.

subject: Dummy Door
text: Blowing up the crushing dummy door with a bomb reveals another door behind it.

evidence.quote: Blow up the door with a bomb.  The dummy door will disappear, revealing another door.

subject: Flare Dancer
text: Using the Hookshot pulls the Flare Dancer's heart free from its flaming body.

evidence.quote: To damage the Flare Dancer, the first thing you must do is separate it's heart from it's flaming body using the Hookshot.

subject: Flare Dancer
text: Circling the room in the opposite direction lets Link intercept the running heart with a jump attack.

evidence.quote: Begin circling the room in the opposite direction so that you intercept it halfway around the room, and use a jump attack to deal damage to it

subject: Upper Flare Dancer Room Center Platform
text: Defeating the Flare Dancer removes the central flames and allows the center platform to rise as an elevator.

evidence.quote: Once the Flare Dancer is dead, then the pillar of flames in the middle of the room will disappear.  Climb up onto the platform in the middle of the room, and it will begin to rise.  Go through the door at the top of the shaft.

subject: Diamond Switch
text: Dropping a bomb from the second floor onto the diamond switch removes the flame pillar surrounding the mesh ladder.

evidence.quote: Once up here, drop a bomb down to the bottom floor, right next to the diamond switch.  The explosion will remove the pillar of flames that surround the mesh ladder leading to the next level.

subject: The Tippy-Top Room Chest
text: The chest at the top of the narrow staircase contains the Megaton Hammer.

evidence.quote: The Fire Temple - The Tippy-Top Room...New Item: Megaton Hammer...step on the switch to make a pillar of flames surrounding a chest near the top of the room disappear.  To reach the chest before time runs out, then you have to run up the narrow staircase on the inside of the giant ring that the room creates.

subject: Stone Face Block
text: Smashing the stone face on the floor with the Megaton Hammer drops the block into the room below.

evidence.quote: Stand on the large stone face coming out of the floor, and smash the face with the Megaton Hammer.  The block will fall down to the room below.

subject: Corner Totem Pole
text: Smashing both pieces of the corner totem pole with the Megaton Hammer reveals a door.

evidence.quote: Smash it with the Megaton Hammer from the left or right until both pieces are gone to reveal a door.
